discontinuity-types.alt: Three graphs, each with a break at x = 2. Removable: the curve has a hole at (2, 3), an open circle, while f(2) = 1 is a closed dot below it; the limit exists. Jump: the left piece ends at a closed dot at (2, 1) and the right piece starts at an open circle at (2, 3); the one-sided limits differ. Infinite: the curve rises without bound on both sides of the dashed vertical asymptote x = 2.
